statusDetail: Authentication, persistence, audit logging and API surface are implemented and verified on SQLite. PostgreSQL migrations were generated but never executed because no server is available; that verification is BLOCKED.

git.commitSubject: feat(phase-1): add authentication, persistence and audit foundation

implemented: Domain, Application and Infrastructure projects containing exercised code
ASP.NET Core Identity accounts with cookie authentication (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, configurable Secure)
Antiforgery double-submit enforcement on every unsafe /api request
Administrator and Analyst roles with first-account bootstrap rule
Password policy (12 chars, upper/lower/digit, 4 unique) and lockout (5 attempts / 15 minutes)
Append-only audit log for auth and administrative actions
EF Core persistence with provider-specific SQLite and PostgreSQL migration assemblies
SQLite DateTimeOffset stored as Unix milliseconds; PostgreSQL uses timestamptz
Validated auth, database and rate-limit options with fail-fast startup
Separate tighter rate-limit policy on registration and login
scopeClarification: The Phase 0 report listed workspace isolation among Phase 1 prerequisites. Workspaces are not implemented in Phase 1; they are the subject of Phase 2. The README status table was corrected accordingly. No workspace table, query filter or isolation test exists yet.
notImplemented: MFA, password reset and e-mail verification

defectsFoundAndFixed.defect: SQLite cannot ORDER BY DateTimeOffset; audit read failed with SQLite Error 1
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Provider-conditional value converter storing UTC as Unix milliseconds; both migration sets regenerated

defectsFoundAndFixed.defect: Authentication setup read RequireSecureCookies eagerly, ignoring configuration added after service registration
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Cookie hardening and session lifetime now bind through IOptions<AuthOptions> post-configuration

defectsFoundAndFixed.defect: Class-scoped test database made bootstrap-Administrator assertions order-dependent
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Fresh factory and database per test via ApiTestBase

defectsFoundAndFixed.defect: Reusing a pre-authentication antiforgery token after sign-in returned 400
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Test client refreshes the token after identity changes; live verification uses a fresh anonymous session

defectsFoundAndFixed.defect: Secure cookie test ran over plain HTTP and hit the framework's SSL-configuration guard
defectsFoundAndFixed.fix: Secure-cookie test now runs over https://localhost through the test server
